study: E13 physical-rank consistency: replace E9 density-proxy R16 wind by separately evolved original-F± direct CLASS vTk R16 wind at z=.945,.95,.955, recompute Gaussian Gamma_ell in EXACT same direct filtered rank as corrected E12b P_delta_cb,r; multiply only as a strictly labeled Newtonian-gauge fixed-short-k unit-bias Gaussian-local squeezed source. No eBOSS observational bispectrum/likelihood.

fixed_inputs.original_CLASS_params_except_psd_output_: E9 original newtonian mPk,dTk,vTk, original cosmological params, original CLASS pinned commit, no integration tolerance retune
fixed_inputs.physical_short_Pcb: classy.cosmo.pk_cb_lin(kshort*h,z=.95), Mpc^3 per separately evolved F state

exact_direct_wind_phase.direct_vLOS_sigma_R16_z: sqrt(1/3 integral_1e-4^0.1 dlnk |c theta_ncdm-cdm/K|² primordial_DeltaR² W(K R16)²); theta=t_ncdm[0]-t_cdm from CLASS vTk. Preserve each state own direct sigma at all three z, coherent common standardized Gaussian rank r.
exact_direct_wind_phase.E9_exact_occupancy_preserving_rescale: alpha_direct_aligned_s(z) = alpha_original_E9_s(z)*[sigma_direct_s(z)/sigma_E9_density_proxy_s(z)]*[f_s(q_direct)/f_s(q_proxy)], q=mnu*sigma/(c*Tnu0*(1+z)); original frozen E8 4000q interpolation and exact FD first Eq20 only.
exact_direct_wind_phase.angular_Gamma: For original E10 EqA8, phi_s(z,mu,r)=alpha_direct_aligned_s(z)*r*mu*[f_s(q_direct(z)*abs(r*mu))/f_s(q_direct(z))]; T_ell=(2ell+1)/2 int_-1^1 P_ell(mu) mu²[-(1+z)d(phi)/dz] dmu; Gamma_direct_ell=E_r[r*T_ell(r)].

corrected_long_cross.raw_E12_per_state: P_(delta_cb,r_direct_raw)_over_i_mu(K) = (2pi²/K³) DeltaR²(K) delta_cb_NEWTONIAN(K) c theta_rel(K)/(K sigma_LOS_direct)
corrected_long_cross.mandatory_E12b_filter: P_(delta_cb,r_direct_R16)_over_i_mu(K) = W_R16(K) * E12 raw P_delta_cb,r_direct(K); if E13 sigma differs numerically from E12 original sigma, also multiply sigma_E12/sigma_E13 so same direct rank is used.
corrected_long_cross.independent_CLASS_center_K_validation: Fresh E13 center t_ncdm-t_cdm and Newtonian delta_cb at all four locked K must match original E12 source to tolerance predeclared as technical 0.1%, else NO modeled long-short product.
corrected_long_cross.P_long_units: Mpc^3 for coefficient of +i mu_L for cross <delta_cb(K) r_LOS*(K)>
corrected_long_cross.source_reduced_bispectrum: B_src_ell/(i mu_long Delta_b) = Gamma_direct_ell(kshort,z)*P_cb_short_CLASS(kshort,z)*P_delta_cb,r_direct_R16_over_i_mu(K,z), units Mpc^6. This is restricted Gaussian local velocity-conditioned EqA8 source in Newtonian gauge, not full galaxy bispectrum or eBOSS prediction.

physical_limits.theory_scope: Locally coherent Gaussian scalar rank and exact EqA8 dipole/octupole short mode, no vector transverse short-long coupling, no full Vlasov halo retardation, no selection-conditioned velocity/hod calibration.
